ppj-state.meaning: Persistent authored state represented directly by office-kit/ppj/v1.
ppj-state.agentRoute: Edit the typed field in the .ppj file, then run ppj check/build.

native-ref.meaning: Imported-source capability represented by opaque/nativeRef and lowered fail-closed by C#.
native-ref.agentRoute: Import, inspect the issued nativeRef capability, edit only declared fields, then rebuild from the bound source.

compiler-helper.meaning: Legacy facade or convenience constructor; not a public PPJ 2.0 authoring primitive.
compiler-helper.agentRoute: Express the resulting state in PPJ. External programs may generate JSON, but Agents do not call this helper.

inspect-review.meaning: Discovery, validation, rendering, review, or package interoperability rather than persistent deck state.
inspect-review.agentRoute: Use the officekit ppj CLI command or review route; do not serialize the operation as slide content.

host-only.meaning: Operation against an open desktop PowerPoint session; never serialized into PPJ.
host-only.agentRoute: Use powerpoint-live-control only when the user explicitly targets the open application.

$.meta.meaning: Stable program identity and revision metadata.

$.intent.meaning: Audience, narrative, editorial and delivery intent.

$.design.meaning: Canvas, theme, styles, design grammar and motion policy.

$.assets.meaning: Content-addressed local media, rights and accessibility metadata.

$.source.meaning: Immutable third-party PPTX source binding and projection proof.

$.components.meaning: Finite parameterized reuse with bounded repeat and conditions.

$.pages.meaning: Ordered pages, backgrounds, notes, motion and true element z-order, including capability-issued full-page or single-component sourceClone reuse and bounded topmost typed overlays.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].data.series[0].levels for treemap and sunburst charts
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: OfficeKit-authored PPTX restores the full hierarchy and exact display-level intent from its embedded PPJ program. Without that private program, only the generated visible shapes import as an editable group; omitted semantic descendants are never inferred from geometry.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Treemap supports 1..8 visible levels and sunburst supports 1..6 while validation retains the complete forest and parent totals. The compiler reflows visible rectangles or ring widths instead of deleting source data or reserving empty geometry. Other chart families, interactive drill-down and per-node visibility expressions fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where chartType is combo and one data.series[].chartType is scatter or bubble
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: OfficeKit-authored PPTX restores the exact numeric combo from its embedded PPJ program. Without that private program, axes and marks import truthfully as an editable group; arbitrary third-party shapes are never inferred as numeric chart data.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The bounded profile owns one shared value/value coordinate system, 2..8 scatter, bubble, line, area or column series and 2..64 strictly increasing finite X/Y points per series. It emits stable editable axes, fills, bars, segments and point marks. Secondary axes, chart formulas, statistical transforms, ChartPart build animation and unsupported styling fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].style.bubbleSizeScale and pages[].elements[].style.bubbleRadiusRange on bubble or numeric combo charts
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: OfficeKit-authored PPTX restores the exact size mapping from its embedded PPJ program. Without that private program, the generated ellipses and axes import truthfully as an editable group; third-party DrawingML groups are never inferred as bubble data.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ can map one shared positive bubble-size domain through sqrt, linear or logarithmic scaling into a strictly increasing 2..72 point radius range. Declaring either field intentionally selects editable vector lowering because ChartML cannot promise exact visible radii or logarithmic transforms. Native ChartPart build animation, formulas, secondary axes, per-series ranges and reverse inference fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where chartType is candlestick and data.series has aligned line, area or column overlays after the OHLC/HLC body
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: OfficeKit-authored PPTX restores the exact candlestick and overlay semantics from its embedded PPJ program. Without that private program, the generated price and overlay marks import truthfully as an editable group; arbitrary third-party groups are not inferred as financial charts.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The first series remains the bounded OHLC/HLC body and up to four aligned overlays may add line, area or column evidence on the same scale. Filled overlays render behind wicks and bodies while line overlays render above them. Numeric X channels, secondary axes, formulas and unsupported overlay topology fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where chartType is bar or column and data.series[0].symbol is present
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: OfficeKit-authored PPTX restores the exact pictographic chart from its embedded PPJ program. Without that private program, repeated units import truthfully as an editable group; arbitrary third-party shapes are never inferred as chart data and receive no pictographic mutation capability.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The compiler expands one bounded series into stable editable named-icon or preset-geometry units. It requires 2..12 categories, exact positive unit divisibility, at most 32 units per category and 192 total. Fractional symbols, multiple series, axes, ChartPart build animation and unsupported series options fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where chartType is area and style.stacking is stream
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: OfficeKit-authored PPTX restores the exact streamgraph from its embedded PPJ program. Without that private program, the generated DrawingML imports truthfully as an editable group; arbitrary third-party paths are never inferred as stream semantics and receive no stream mutation capability.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The compiler owns a bounded centered silhouette with 2..12 complete non-negative series over 3..64 ordered categories. It emits stable editable cubic paths and labels. Native ChartParts have no centered-stream stacking mode, so ChartPart build animation, negative or missing values, secondary axes, per-point labels and unsupported series options fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: native chart labels, leader lines, plot scalars, legend placement/overlay/fill, bubble scale, blank-cell modes, axis positions, axis lines and minor units
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].displayBlanksAs; pages[].elements[].style.dataLabels, pages[].elements[].data.series[].dataLabels, pages[].elements[].style.legend/legendOverlay/legendFill/stacking/gapWidth/smooth/varyColors/bubbleScale/bubbleSizeMode and pages[].elements[].xAxis/yAxis/secondaryXAxis/secondaryYAxis title/reverse/visible/numberFormat/tickLabelInterval/min/max/majorUnit/minorUnit/tickLabelsVisible/tickLabelPosition/axisLine/gridLine
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized imported ChartParts issue setChartLabels for plot defaults plus bounded series defaults and sparse zero-based point overrides, including presence-aware bubble-size and leader-line visibility at native plot and series-default scopes for charts, setChartPlot for common legend placement/overlay/stacking/gap/axis visibility/gridline/line-option scalars, setChartFill for bounded legend surface fill, native bubble/circular size semantics, and chart-level displayBlanksAs, and setChartAxis for bounded axis titles/direction, number-format, numeric bounds/units, presence-aware value-axis minor units, bounded tick-label positions/visibility/intervals, direct axis/grid line styling, and kind-checked grammar token references. Each capability owns only its declared field group and patches the existing ChartPart.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ owns plot-, series- and sparse point-level label visibility, including presence-aware bubble-size visibility for bubble charts and bubble series plus leader-line visibility at native plot and series-default scopes, common plot enums/integers/booleans including legend positions (`top`, `topRight`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`), presence-aware legend overlay, and bounded legend none/solid/gradient surface fill, chart-level displayBlanksAs (`zero`, `gap`, `span`) with presence and grammar-token resolution, native data-label positions, direct number format and bounded typography; bubble scale from 0 through 300; native area/width size semantics; presence-aware axis reversal, finite numeric bounds/units, value-axis minor units and tick intervals, native axis tick-label positions (`nextTo`, `high`, `low`, `none`), and direct RGB/no-fill axis and major-grid lines. Exact visible radii and logarithmic sizing are a separate authored vector capability, not a native source-bound ChartPart mutation. Point-level leader-line flags, custom label text/layout/shape/effect/leader-line geometry, source-linked formats, theme/effect line graphs, category-axis and vector-fallback minor-unit forms, and unsupported topology remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].data.series[].pointStyles
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Canonical imported bar, column, pie and doughnut ChartParts project bounded c:dPt state and reuse setChartFill. A source-bound edit adds, replaces or removes only sorted sparse point fill, outline or legal explosion state inside the existing ChartPart before a second projection proves the requested semantics.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ owns zero-based point indexes, none/solid/gradient direct fill, bounded RGB outline and pie/doughnut explosion from 0 through 400. Missing points, marker overrides, picture options, 3D state, effects, extensions, unknown children and irregular paint or line graphs remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: native chart series stroke and markers
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].data.series[].stroke and pages[].elements[].data.series[].marker
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized imported line, scatter and radar ChartParts expose line/scatter/radar marker identity, size, direct RGB/alpha fill and marker outline through setChartSeriesStyle; non-scatter series direct stroke uses the same capability. A bounded source-bound edit adds, replaces or removes only these series style nodes inside the existing ChartPart and then proves a second projection.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The native reader/writer owns the finite marker catalog (none, dot, circle, square, diamond, triangle, x, star, plus, dash), sizes 2 through 72, direct RGB paint, bounded dash/width/cap/join/opacity, and line/scatter/radar family checks. Scatter series lines, theme/transformed colors, picture/effect marker graphs, unsupported family markers and irregular ChartML remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: native chart trendlines and scalar error bars
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].data.series[].trendlines and pages[].elements[].data.series[].errorBars
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized imported bar/column or line ChartParts expose the existing bounded c:trendline and scalar c:errBars children through setChartSeriesAnalytics. A source-bound edit may replace the values of an existing same-count trendline list or existing scalar error-bar object inside the ChartPart and then proves a second projection; adding, removing, or changing child topology fails closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The shared ChartSpace codecs already own six trendline types, polynomial/moving-average constraints, forecast/intercept/display flags, bounded direct line styling, and fixed-value/percentage/standard-deviation/standard-error error bars. Custom error-bar data, formulas/workbook synchronization, extensions, 3D/complex combo semantics, and topology changes remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].xAxis/yAxis/secondaryXAxis/secondaryYAxis.axisLineArrow.start/end
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Canonical imported ordinary chart axes project finite endpoint names and reuse setChartAxis. A bounded edit adds, replaces or removes only recognized a:headEnd/a:tailEnd state inside the existing editable axis line container and then re-proves the ChartPart semantics.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ owns none, triangle, stealth, diamond, oval and open start/end axis arrowheads. Endpoint size metadata, effects, unknown children, arrows on grid/series/radar-spoke lines, generated vector axes and irregular native line topology remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where chartType is radar and spokeAxis declares show/min/max/majorUnit/label/axisLine/gridLine
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Canonical imported standard-radar ChartParts project one semantic spokeAxis and issue setChartAxis, plus setChartTextStyle when label typography is editable. A bounded edit patches only the existing category/value axis pair and preserves the chart topology and unrelated native content.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ maps axisLine to radial spokes, gridLine to concentric rings, and the numeric scale plus label visibility/format/typography to the native value axis. Custom label positions, reverse radar direction, logarithmic scales, axis arrows, theme/effect line graphs, filled or 3D radar variants, extensions and irregular axis topology remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].style.startAngle and pages[].elements[].style.holeSize
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized imported pie and doughnut ChartParts issue setChartPlot for the bounded chart.plot field. PPJ may change first-slice angle and, for doughnuts, center-hole size without changing series topology or rebuilding the chart.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The compiler owns native c:firstSliceAng from 0 through 360 and c:holeSize from 10 through 90. Other plot options and incompatible chart families fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].text.paragraphs[].runs[].formula
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: An authored formula may be added inside ordinary compiler-owned rich text, including one eligible topmost typed text overlay on a source-bound page. Third-party a14:m/OMML is preserved but is never reverse-translated into guessed LaTeX, and existing imported formulas receive no mutation capability.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ compiles one bounded, non-executable LaTeX subset to canonical editable Office Math and restores the exact source only from an embedded PPJ snapshot. Arbitrary TeX, raw OMML, environments, macros and unsupported formula styling fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].text.paragraphs[].style.tabStops and noTabStops
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized text bodies issue setTextParagraphStyle for fixed-topology tab-stop edits. PPJ positions are expressed in points and lower to the owning paragraph's a:tabLst; noTabStops explicitly removes only that modeled list.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Only a single direct tab-stop list with bounded left, center, right or decimal alignment is modeled. Inherited list styles, malformed lists, reflow and other paragraph extensions remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].style or textStyle
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized fixed-topology text, shape-text and placeholder bodies issue setTextBodyStyle when their direct a:bodyPr state is within the bounded profile. Existing body-property leaves can be changed in place without adding a body or rewriting paragraph/run topology.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile owns vertical alignment, wrapping, insets, columns, column gap/direction, vertical-text mode, rotation, overflow, upright, canonical normAutofit percentages, and the bounded direct flatTx z coordinate. Inheritance, explicit deletion and unknown/effect-rich bodyPr state remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].rows[].cells[].text.style
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized fixed-topology table cells expose a structured rich-text text.style object and reuse setTableCellStyle/table.cell.textStyle to patch the existing a:bodyPr leaves.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The bounded profile owns direct vertical alignment, wrapping, insets, columns, column gap/direction, vertical-text, rotation, overflow, upright, canonical normAutofit percentages, and flatTextZ when those body-property values have a textBoxStyle spelling. Explicit delete markers, inheritance and unknown bodyPr extensions remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where type is icon
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: An authored icon may be added as a topmost typed overlay on an eligible source-bound page. Ordinary third-party custom geometry projects truthfully as shape or opaque content and is never inferred back into an icon name.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ resolves an exact bundled Font Awesome Free name to one finite editable DrawingML custom path. Unknown names, arbitrary SVG paths, external icon providers and semantic inference from native geometry fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: design.styles.shape[].style.glow, design.styles.image[].style.glow, and pages[].elements[] where type is shape, line, or image
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct glow for compiler-owned shapes, lines and pictures. Imported/source-bound ordinary shape, line and picture glow now expose the same direct owner and scalar leaves; broader effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile owns one direct RGB or theme color, a 0..1000 point radius and numeric or opacity-token opacity, lowering to a:glow before an optional a:outerShdw. The source-bound profile accepts only direct glow or glow followed by one bounded outer shadow and token-splices the selected owner scalar; reflection, inner shadow, 3-D and arbitrary multi-effect graphs remain outside this owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: authored shape and image inner shadow
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: design.styles.shape[].style.innerShadow, design.styles.image[].style.innerShadow, and pages[].elements[] where type is shape, line, or image
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct inner shadow for compiler-owned shapes, lines and pictures. Imported/source-bound ordinary shape, line and picture inner shadow now expose the same direct owner and scalar leaves; broader effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile owns direct RGB or theme color, bounded blur/distance/angle and numeric or opacity-token opacity, lowering to a:innerShdw before an optional a:outerShdw. The source-bound profile accepts only direct inner shadow or inner shadow followed by one bounded outer shadow and token-splices the selected owner scalar; glow, reflection, soft edge, 3-D and arbitrary multi-effect graphs remain outside this owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: authored shape and image soft edge
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: design.styles.shape[].style.softEdge, design.styles.image[].style.softEdge, and pages[].elements[] where type is shape, line, or image
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct soft edge for compiler-owned shapes, lines and pictures. Imported/source-bound ordinary shape, line, and picture soft edge expose the same owner-specific radius leaf and SlidePart-only token splice; broader effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile owns one 0..1000 point radius and lowers it to a:softEdge after the bounded glow and outer-shadow owners. The source-bound profile accepts direct soft edge, outer shadow followed by soft edge, or full-span reflection followed by soft edge, and preserves the preceding effect while splicing only rad. Glow, inner shadow, 3-D and arbitrary multi-effect graphs remain outside this owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: authored shape and image inner shadow
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: design.styles.shape[].style.innerShadow, design.styles.image[].style.innerShadow, and pages[].elements[] where type is image
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct inner shadow for compiler-owned shapes, lines and pictures. Imported/source-bound inner shadow and broader effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile owns direct RGB or theme color, bounded blur/distance/angle, and numeric or opacity-token opacity, lowering to a:innerShdw between the glow and outer-shadow owners. Reflection, 3-D, arbitrary multi-effect graphs and source-bound inner-shadow editing are outside this authored owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: design.styles.shape[].style.reflection, design.styles.image[].style.reflection, and pages[].elements[] where type is shape, line, or image
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct reflection for compiler-owned shapes, lines and pictures. Imported/source-bound ordinary shapes, lines, and pictures expose the same direct owner and scalar leaves; broader effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile owns bounded blur, start/end opacity, distance and direction, lowering to a:reflection with full-span positions after an optional outer shadow. The source-bound profile accepts only direct reflection or outer shadow followed by reflection and token-splices the selected owner scalar; glow, inner shadow, soft edge, 3-D, transform variants and arbitrary multi-effect graphs remain outside this owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: textStyle.glow across paragraph defaultText, rich-text run styles, named text styles and authored layout/master text defaults
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct text glow for authored runs and paragraph default runs. A strict imported/source-bound profile now projects direct rich-text run glow and issues radius, RGB/theme color, and existing explicit-alpha native leaves; paragraph defaultText also issues textDefaultGlowRadiusEmu, textDefaultGlowColorRgb, textDefaultGlowColorScheme, and textDefaultGlowOpacityThousandthPercent for the direct glow radius/RGB/theme color/explicit alpha, while other default-text glow scalars and effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The authored profile reuses direct RGB/theme color, 0..1000 point radius and numeric or opacity-token opacity, lowering to a:glow before the existing bounded text outer-shadow owner. The source-bound profile accepts only one direct glow or glow followed by one bounded outer shadow, preserves color topology, and token-splices the selected run scalar as proven by PpjSourceBoundTextGlowEditsDirectRunOwnerAndReprojects. The paragraph defaultText profile proves the same owner and token-splices only glow/@rad, the direct glow/srgbClr/@val or glow/schemeClr/@val, or one existing direct color alpha a:alpha/@val. Text reflection, inner shadow, soft edge, WordArt and arbitrary effect lists remain outside this owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: textStyle.innerShadow across paragraph defaultText, rich-text run styles, named text styles and authored layout/master text defaults
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct text inner shadow for authored runs and paragraph default runs. A strict imported/source-bound profile now projects direct rich-text run inner shadow and issues existing geometry, RGB/theme color, and explicit-alpha native leaves; paragraph defaultText exposes textDefaultInnerShadowBlurRadiusEmu, textDefaultInnerShadowDistanceEmu, textDefaultInnerShadowDirectionDegrees, textDefaultInnerShadowColorRgb, textDefaultInnerShadowColorScheme, and textDefaultInnerShadowOpacityThousandthPercent for direct blur/distance/direction/RGB/theme color/explicit alpha, while its separate glow-radius and soft-edge-radius leaves are documented below. Other text effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The authored profile reuses direct RGB/theme color, bounded blur/distance/angle and numeric or opacity-token opacity, lowering to a:innerShdw between the bounded text glow and outer-shadow owners. The source-bound profile accepts only one direct inner shadow or inner shadow followed by one bounded outer shadow, preserves color topology, and token-splices the selected run scalar as proven by PpjSourceBoundTextInnerShadowEditsDirectRunOwnerAndReprojects. The paragraph defaultText profile proves the same owner and token-splices only innerShdw/@blurRad, innerShdw/@dist, innerShdw/@dir, the direct innerShdw/srgbClr/@val or innerShdw/schemeClr/@val, or one existing direct color/alpha innerShdw/*Clr/a:alpha/@val. Text glow, reflection, soft edge, WordArt and arbitrary effect lists remain outside this owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: textStyle.reflection across paragraph defaultText, rich-text run styles, named text styles and authored layout/master text defaults
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct text reflection for authored runs and paragraph default runs. A strict imported/source-bound profile now projects one full-span direct rich-text run reflection, optionally preceded by one valid outer shadow, and issues the existing scalar leaves; paragraph defaultText also exposes textDefaultReflectionBlurRadiusEmu, textDefaultReflectionDistanceEmu, textDefaultReflectionStartOpacityThousandthPercent, textDefaultReflectionEndOpacityThousandthPercent, and textDefaultReflectionDirectionDegrees alongside the separate glow, inner-shadow and soft-edge radius leaves documented below. Other text effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile reuses bounded blur, start/end opacity, distance and angle, lowering to a:reflection with deterministic full-span positions after the bounded text glow, inner-shadow and outer-shadow owners. The source-bound profile accepts only a full-span reflection or outer-shadow→reflection, preserves the owner proof and token-splices the selected run scalar as proven by PpjSourceBoundTextReflectionEditsDirectRunOwnerAndReprojects; the paragraph defaultText profile proves the same full-span owner and token-splices only reflection/@blurRad, reflection/@dist, reflection/@stA, reflection/@endA, or reflection/@dir. 3-D, reflection transform variants, WordArt and arbitrary effect lists remain outside this owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: textStyle.softEdge across paragraph defaultText, rich-text run styles, named text styles and authored layout/master text defaults
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded direct text soft edge for authored runs and paragraph default runs. A strict imported/source-bound profile now projects one direct rich-text run soft edge, optionally preceded by one valid outer shadow or full-span reflection, and issues the existing radius leaf; the matching paragraph defaultText owner issues textDefaultSoftEdgeRadiusEmu with a paragraph-index proof. Other text effect graphs remain source-preserved or fail closed.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile reuses a 0..1000 point radius, lowering to a:softEdge after the bounded text glow, inner-shadow, outer-shadow and reflection owners. The source-bound run profile accepts only a direct soft edge, outer-shadow→soft-edge or full-span reflection→soft-edge, preserves the preceding owner proof and token-splices the selected run radius; the defaultText profile proves direct a:p/a:pPr/a:defRPr ownership and token-splices its softEdge/@rad, as covered by PpjSourceBoundTextSoftEdgeEditsDirectRunOwnerAndReprojects and its focused default-text extension. 3-D, WordArt and arbitrary effect lists remain outside this authored owner.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: connector.frame
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Imported placement and transform topology remains source-preserved unless a matching typed capability is issued.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Shape, text, placeholder, image, chart, table and group frames own rotation/flips; connector orientation remains endpoint-derived.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: structured chart titles and other chart typography
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: chart.title, chart.style.titleTextStyle, chart.style.legendTextStyle, chart.style.dataLabels.textStyle and chart axes textStyle/titleTextStyle
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Bounded multi-paragraph/run chart titles are projected and editable through setChartTitle; canonical legend, data-label, axis-title and axis tick-label typography remains editable through setChartTextStyle. Unsupported title containers remain source-preserved.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Authored ordinary and combo charts own structured title runs plus Latin/East Asian typefaces, size, bold, italic and direct RGB/alpha. Formula-backed titles, hyperlinks, theme transforms, WordArt, shadows, effects and unknown title topology remain outside the bounded profile.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where type is media and nativeRef is present
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Imported audio/video pictures, media relationships and timing graphs remain opaque-preserved unless a future capability proves the complete playback closure.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Source-free PPJ owns a bounded canonical audio/video profile with an explicit poster, trim, loop and mute. It does not claim arbitrary third-party triggers, bookmarks, media effects or timing topology.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].locked
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: A recognized unlocked baseline or complete OfficeKit lock profile issues setLocked. Partial flags, extension-bearing locks and unknown combinations remain source-owned. Element visibility is proven separately and may still issue setHidden.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: One PPJ boolean cannot preserve the intent of every type-specific DrawingML lock combination without erasing native information.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where type is ole
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Imported OLE objects are classified and preserved; only issued nativeRef or typed capabilities may change them.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: PPJ models OLE persistent state, but authored native OLE creation is not compiler-owned.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[] where type is smartArt
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Authored PPJ emits one native diagram frame with data, layout, style, colors and cached-drawing parts. Custom definition assets execute bounded placement, gap, column and reverse operators and round-trip as content-addressed JSON. OfficeKit-owned native graphs issue text, connection, frame and verified detach capabilities; a picture-layout graph whose cached drawing has one embedded blip per node additionally projects canonical stretch/tile crop/opacity paint and issues setSmartArtImage/setSmartArtImagePaint for replacing an existing content-addressed node asset or its cached paint. Every closed third-party diagram projects as typed SmartArt: proven nodes and parent edges are editable by issued text leaves, while unknown graphs stay typed read-only with path-independent section hashes.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Arbitrary DiagramML programs, unsupported operator kinds, shared or external native closures, multiple/effect-bearing/linked picture blips and unverified caches fail closed. Picture asset/image add/remove and topology edits are not exposed. detachToShapes is explicit and reports semantic loss.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: native-theme bullet identity and uncommon numbering schemes
authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: text.paragraphs[].style.bullet
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Existing paragraph bullet leaves are editable only when capability-issued.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Authored bullets accept literal RGB/alpha or deck-local color tokens resolved to RGB/alpha, plus the documented decimal, alpha and Roman schemes. Existing native theme-token identity remains source-bound and leaf-editable rather than being guessed during source-free authoring.
